question: Who was the Minister of State (Independent Charge) of the Ministry of Planning as on 31st July 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rao Inderjit Singh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rao Inderjit Singh**__

 __
 
• **He was the Minister of State (Independent Charge) of the Ministry of Planning as of 31st July 2020. Hence, Option 2 is correct.**
 
• He belongs to Rewari (Ahirwal).
 
• He is an Indian politician and a Minister of State (Independent Charge) in the Government of India.
 
• **A member of the 17th Lok Sabha, the lower house of the Parliament of India, he represents Gurugram in Haryana and is a member of the Bharatiya Janata Party.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Shripad Yesso Naik **__

 __
 
• **He was born on 4th October 1952 at Adpai village, North Goa District, Goa. **
 
• **Shripad Yesso Naik is the Union Minister of State (Independent Charge) in the Ministry of Ayurveda, Yoga & Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha, and Homoeopathy (AYUSH) and Minister of State for Defence.**
 
• He was the former Union Minister of State for Health and Family Welfare.
 
• He is the Member of Parliament from the North Goa constituency.
 
 
 
• ​**Kiren Rijiju**__
 __
 
• **He is a politician from Arunachal Pradesh who is the face of the BJP in the Northeast.**
 
• He represents the Arunachal West constituency in the present Lok Sabha and is a Minister of State for Home Affairs in the Narendra Modi Cabinet.
 
 
 
• **Santosh Kumar Gangwar **__
 
 
• **He is an Indian politician and the former Minister of State with an independent charge in the Ministry of Labour and Employment in the Government of India.**
 
• He is a Member of Parliament, a former minister of state in the Government of India, and a leader of the Bharatiya Janata Party.
